main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Gnosis allows us to free ourselves from matter
header_desc: By intertwining first-century spirituality with twenty-first-century physics, this work addresses the primordial question of our place in the cosmos. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in two-thousand-year-old texts: the Gnostic gospels confirm that the Pleroma exists beyond our Universe.
left_title: The Return ✝️ to the ONE ❤️: The ego 🧠 has mass ┻
left_body: Matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. If the ego curves spacetime, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche, and the timeless responds to the pneuma. Consciousness oscillates between the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, granting us a free will of perception formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one becomes a profound invitation to shed the false self and return to the pure light of the Invisible Father: the prison is a curved spacetime, and the Pleroma is a flat spacetime.
universe_light_text: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (La Patria Grande).
center_text: Free yourself from the Demiurge, you sleep in a prison with open doors: the wisdom of Sophia in the right hemisphere versus the ignorance of Yaldabaoth in the left hemisphere shows the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The flight of science and spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why the laws of Newton and Maxwell do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's break of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual assembly: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi find (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as the soul's confinement. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the Demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and the Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening announced by the Mayan cosmogony. The cosmological question about the origin of Yaldabaoth and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent realm of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Brain Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The orwellian doublethink mechanism (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The capital affirmation: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation before the question of questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of more than two trillion galaxies? The paradox of cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it does not make much sense to pray to the law of gravity
